user.title: Layers
user.description: Choose the lamps Layers manages and what a manual change means by default. Layers never commands a lamp until an automation puts a layer on it, and it starts with commanding switched off (observe only).

data.default_policy: When someone changes a lamp by hand

data_description.entities: Individual lamps and switches only. Light groups, switch groups and vendor room groups are rejected: Layers expands them itself. A switch is held on or off; brightness and colour do not apply to it.
data_description.default_policy: Take it back: the change becomes the lamp's base and the layers above it are dropped on that lamp. Edit active layer: the change goes into the layer on top. Keep layers: the change becomes the base, the layers stay.

error.not_a_lamp: These are groups or have no state and cannot be managed: {entities}

data.default_policy: When someone changes a lamp by hand
data.edit_active_entities: Lamps where a manual change edits the active layer
data.base_keep_layers_entities: Lamps where a manual change keeps the layers
data.reassert_entities: Entities where a change with no context is the device misbehaving: the layers are put back (a smart plug that comes back on by itself). App and automation changes still take it back; never for anything with a wall switch.
data.climate_manual_priority: Climate: priority of a person's change

data_description.climate_manual_priority: A change Layers did not make to a thermostat becomes the `manual` layer at this priority. Layers below it (holiday, away, night) stay underneath; soft layers at or above it are taken back; sticky and locked layers above it (an open window) keep showing, and the change comes back when they are cleared.
data_description.climate_manual_timeout: After this long the manual layer runs out and the thermostat goes back to what is below it. 0: until it is cleared (`layers.clear layer: manual`).
data_description.climate_report_window: How long after Layers' own command a thermostat may take to report it. A change with no context inside this window is the device answering late; outside it, it is a person.

error.holds_layers: Clear the layers on these lamps before removing them: {entities}
error.not_enrolled: These lamps are not in the managed list: {entities}
error.both_policies: A lamp can only have one policy: {entities}

options.take_back: Take it back (drop the layers on that lamp)
options.base_keep_layers: Keep the layers (change the base only)

render_failed.title: Layers could not set {entity_id}
render_failed.description: Layers sent {entity_id} its command {attempts} times and the lamp never reported it. It will try again the next time that lamp's layers change, or on `layers.sync`.

priority_required.message: Layer {layer} does not exist yet on {entity_id}: give it a priority.

priority_conflict.message: Priority {priority} is already held by layer {other} on {entity_id}. Each layer on a lamp needs its own priority.

no_targets.message: None of the targets is a lamp Layers manages.

set.name: Set layer
set.description: Put a layer on lamps or thermostats, update it, or change their base or active layer.

layer.name: Layer
layer.description: A layer id (lowercase letters, digits, underscores), or `base`, or `active` for whichever layer is on top.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: 1-99. Higher sits on top. Needed when the layer does not exist yet.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: set decides on/off (or the HVAC mode) and its attributes; adjust only changes attributes of a lamp that is already on, or shifts a thermostat's temperature by an offset; follow is adjust with its brightness and colour read from a source entity.

state.name: State
state.description: on or off. Not used with adjust.

xy_color.name: XY colour
xy_color.description: [x, y]. The most faithful colour for lamps that desaturate hs or rgb.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Seconds, if the lamp supports it.

ttl.name: Time to live
ttl.description: The layer expires after this long unless it is set again (a lease).

until.name: Until
until.description: The layer expires at this time.

resume_after_manual.name: Resume after manual change
resume_after_manual.description: If a person takes the lamp back, allow this layer again once the lamp has been off.

on_expire.name: On expiry
on_expire.description: safe: an expiry may only turn the lamp off or dim it, and never turns a thermostat on. render: it restores whatever is below, even if that turns the lamp or the heating on.

only_if_present.name: Only if present
only_if_present.description: Refresh the layer where it already is; never create it.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Who set this layer, for the log and diagnostics.

source.name: Source
source.description: follow only: the entity whose brightness and colour attributes the layer follows, such as an Adaptive Lighting switch or a template sensor.

manual_timeout.name: Manual timeout
manual_timeout.description: follow only: after someone changes the lamp by hand, what they changed follows again after this long. Without it, it follows again when the lamp is turned off.

strength.name: Strength
strength.description: What someone else's change does to this layer. soft (default): it takes the lamp back. sticky: a scene, a wall button or another automation goes underneath and the layer stays; changing this lamp itself removes it. locked: every change goes underneath; only clearing the layer (or turning Apply off) ends it.

hvac_mode.name: HVAC mode
hvac_mode.description: Climate entities: off, heat, cool, heat_cool, auto, dry or fan_only. Left out, a layer keeps the mode below it.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Climate entities: the target temperature, in the entity's unit. Rounded to the thermostat's step.

preset_mode.name: Preset
preset_mode.description: Climate entities: a preset the thermostat lists (eco, away, ...). A preset and a temperature replace both below them.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Climate entities, mode: adjust only: added to the temperature below (-2 is two degrees lower), only while the thermostat is not off.

clear.name: Clear layer
clear.description: Remove a layer. The lamps fall back to whatever is below it now.

layer.name: Layer
layer.description: A layer id, `active` for the top layer, or `all` (`active` and `all` need a target). The base cannot be cleared.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Seconds, if the lamp supports it.

sync.name: Sync
sync.description: Send lamps what their layers say they should show. The only way to repair lamps left out of step on purpose (observe-only mode, kept manual changes).

get.name: Get layers
get.description: Return each lamp's or thermostat's base, layers, effective command and status.
